title: A Mother's Love: The Strongest Bond
excerpt: A touching story about the unbreakable bond between a mother and her child.
fullContent:
Mothers and their children have a special relationship. It goes through ups and downs, twists and turns. It's beautiful and magical, but also educational and full of learning experiences. The values and life lessons we learn from our parents shape who we are as people.

When we're growing up at home, we take in everything our parents do and say. When we are babies, they hold and feed us. They care for us and help us grow into children. When we are children, they teach us how to be polite, converse and communicate with peers.

Then we become teenagers, and they aren't holding our hand everywhere anymore. Partially because we want to feel 'grown up' and partially because they want to watch us mature. But even though they don't spend as much time with us, they still hold us in their hearts.

And once we enter our twenties, we become the adults.

I know technically 18 is an adult, but to me, my 18-year-old self had lots of growing to do in order to be the person I am today. I am constantly learning and maturing in Boston now, away from my parents. It's interesting how our surroundings shape and change who we are. Over the past two years, I've slowly become someone that feels authentic to me, little by little.

But that's all thanks to my mom. She taught me the importance of awareness, loyalty, compassion and openness. She's always made me feel safe, and her voice has always been so special to me.

The values my mom taught me growing up are the values I search for in my friendships and the world around me. Having core values that I stand by and finding friends with the same values is magical.

I hope everyone finds a person who feels like home.

That person for me is my mom. Because regardless of whether we are angry or annoyed with each other, I can talk to her about anything, and she will be there for me.

I want to preach the importance of role models and people you look up to. Those people help shape who you are. Your role model may be Rihanna, your grandma, your brother, a parent or whoever else inspires you.

Whoever that may be, hold onto them, and they will hold onto you. I think everyone can benefit from a parental relationship.

Sometimes I long for those days when my brother and I would play outside after school while our parents watched us. Those days are simple and blissful and bring me joy. I think everyone misses those days and those moments when we could just be kids, only ever worrying about what we were going to do during recess.

I will say I miss those days sometimes, but I also remember how those days brought me to where I am today. Everything my parents taught me during those years shaped me as a person.

The values I learned at home and at school in 'Lessons and Living' — a class specifically dedicated to teaching children how to be compassionate — are what I remember most about my childhood.

Even during school, my mom was with me. She taught in my elementary and middle school where I was able to put her lessons to good use with my peers. But it wasn't hard to get along with the kids at my school because they were all special in their own way. It's funny — regardless of how different we all were, we were all brought up in the same way.

So thank you mom for bringing me to a life-changing school and showing me the ropes of life. Thank you for supporting me and my dreams. Thank you for looking out for me and loving me, always and forever.

I owe it all to you.

title: Healthy Habits for Moms
excerpt: Simple and effective health tips every mom should know.
fullContent:
What does this look like in practice in a busy mom's week? Here are a few brief thoughts:

Bible: Find a time each day when you have five minutes to be quiet and alone. Work your way through a physical Bible, preferably with a Bible reading plan that keeps you moving through Scripture. If that's a struggle, consider choosing a 'Bible in a year' program that has a smartphone app, where you can listen to the audio of each day's Scripture reading while you drive or do errands.

Church: This one is most straightforward. Make church on Sunday a priority! If there's one thing worth the (admittedly Herculean) effort of getting your family out the door to (or online) each week, it's church. Ideally you invest in more than just Sunday mornings—a Bible study or small group, or a Zoom book group—but if showing up on Sunday each week is all you can do, it's a big win for you and your family's wisdom.

Nature: Find a time each week to go on a walk as a family (for us it's Saturday mornings). It could be in your neighborhood, in a park, along the beach, or further afield. But prioritize being outside at least weekly.

Books: Instead of filling those 10-minute gaps in your day with fruitless scrolling on your smartphone, use it to read a few pages in a book! Pick two books to go through at any given time: one for when you have the capacity to think deeply, and one for when you just need escape. In both cases it will be time better spent than aimless scrolling or swiping on a screen.

Beauty: This one is easier than you think, and it pairs well with prioritizing rest. Take an evening to enjoy a movie with your spouse. Listen to a playlist of great music as you make dinner. Make music or create other arts and crafts with your whole family. Practice creativity and enjoy it. It'll help make you wise.

Internet and Social Media: It's not that you should quit your online activity cold turkey. If you did you wouldn't be reading this! What's important is going online with a purpose, and staying online only as long as you need to. Above all, avoid the 'aimless wandering' mode of online life, where you open your phone at a stoplight or while standing in line at Starbucks, with no real reason except that it's now an instinctive habit. When you have gaps in your day, avoid grabbing for your phone! In those precious free moments, it's more fruitful to just be alone with your thoughts.

If you and your family can spend a little less time online and a little more time lending your hearts, souls, and minds to more trustworthy and edifying sources of truth, you'll be on a sturdier foundation for a life of wisdom.

title: The inspirational story of one of the greatest mothers in the world
excerpt: Stories of everyday mothers who inspire us all.
fullContent:
I believe that Mother's Day should not be limited to one day only. Because a day is not enough to praise their virtues. Every day should be Mother's Day. All the mothers of the world deserve to be blessed with kind words and loving addresses every day.

Sometimes the lessons our life teaches us are quite painful. Some are very beautiful. But whatever the result, we should learn something from it all and live a successful life. Today I am bringing you such a story. It is about a courageous woman who successfully overcomes a bitter lesson that life teaches us. Let's talk about this today.

She is a mother of two children. I will call her Soumya. She is a woman who works day and night to take care of her children after the death of her husband. She is a courageous woman who has never left her children to starve even though she has no food in her stomach.

Her husband supported his family with the meager income he earned from wage labor. Therefore, he did not manage to save any money. The four of them lived a very poor life and suffered a lot to get food for their stomachs. With the death of her husband, they were left with only the hut they lived in until now.

She earned enough money to feed herself every day by providing manual labor to the households. It was enough to meet the food needs of his children and himself. But education is one of the basic needs of children. As her children reached school age, her heart trembled with fear. Because she was not strong enough to face the difficult challenge in front of her. Every day she chants a certain phrase in her mind like a mantra. Those words always encouraged her.

' My dear children, I am sorry..! I know you are suffering a lot. I have had to fight a great battle to quench your hunger. But children, I never consider it pain. You two are the most precious thing I have. You are like my breath. I will secure your future. I will make every sacrifice for it. Until the day I lose my limbs, I will strive to give you a safe future. I will take care of you, I will give you a good education, I will protect you from a thousand troubles and obstacles, and I will make you good citizens of the society.'

I prefer to call her a festive woman. If she wanted, her children could have been raised without education. But she always thought that she should not pass on the suffering she was going through to her children. Especially since she had two daughters, hard work is a must to secure their future.

Therefore, she decided to give her children the best possible education by using all her energy. Encouraged by that, she started earning money day and night. She was tempted to do every job she could get her hands on. She faced all the evils that a woman without a husband has to face when living alone in society. Therefore, she always thought that she would never allow her daughters to suffer such an unfair fate.

Once, the owner of the house she worked for attacked her because she broke some valuable glass vases in the house. In modern society where humanity has fallen to the penny, she has no one to comfort her. She cried alone countless times. But she always encouraged her daughters.

' Every sorrow and pain that I go through like this, one day my children will make society safe. They will become high and virtuous people in society. They will lead a life as an example amid my sorrows and sighs today. My dear daughters, never take a step back. Remember to move forward with courage and effort. Always fill your life with meaning. '

Because only those tears were there to help her. There is no attempt she did not make to hide her tears from her daughters. Can there be anything more precious than the dedication and affection of such a mother?

Soumya's two daughters completed their primary education and chose medicine and computer technology for their secondary education. And when they were old enough to understand their mother's pain, both of them understood the immeasurable sacrifices their mother had made for them for so long. The only goal they both had in mind was a way to end their mother's suffering. Therefore, both of them engaged in education with great dedication and determination.

Due to their talent, they were able to win valuable scholarships for secondary education. Both of them went abroad for that. It was very difficult to even put into words the happiness that Soumya felt that day. She hugged her two daughters and wept with overflowing happiness in her heart. But being separated from her daughters was a very difficult task. It was the same with the daughters. They also had no intention of leaving their beloved mother alone. But for the sake of the future they sought, they encouraged themselves to accept that difficult decision anyway.

Even when the two daughters returned to their small hut almost two years after completing their graduation, Soumya was there for them. It was a very emotional moment as they were seeing their mother after many years. Seeing them, Soumya hugged both of them at the same time and started crying. Finally, she said something like this.

' My dear daughters, You have conquered the world. You have inherited a beautiful future. Now you have everything you need to live a beautiful life. So don't delay any longer. don't stop Go ahead. Help people. Keep them alive. Live like good people… '

Her hands were as rough as a man's hands from years of hard work. Her face is slightly wrinkled. Limbs are thin. She can't see well. They did not want to leave the dear mother who had sacrificed her life for them even one more moment in this little plant.

They both called their mother and went to a very beautiful house. They said that they bought the house for themselves after placing the keys of the house on Soumya's hands.

Soumya's loving eyes were fixed on her daughters. They have conquered life. Soumya explained to them that seeing the success of both of them was the greatest gift she could give for her years of dedication. At that moment, they promised to stay with their beloved mother every day from now on.

There are many such courageous mothers in this world. They sacrifice everything for the lives of their children. Although their every day is filled with challenges, they never shirk their duties towards their children. I hope that this letter will be an honor to all such courageous mothers.

I pray that the little story I have written like this will be a tribute to all the mothers of the world on Mother's Day. Also, I kindly request you to appreciate your beloved mothers to the fullest not only on Mother's Day but every day. Let's not set aside just one day for the mothers who have raised us so hard, but treat every day as their day.

Always treat mothers with love. Let's cherish them. remember Although I talked more about mothers because of Mother's Day, keep in mind that it is imperative to show such love to our beloved fathers.

Comment your honest opinion about this story below. And don't forget to share this story with everyone. See you again in an article like this.

Thank you very much for your valuable reading time..!

JC.Renolds

' Is your mother such a courageous woman? How special is she to you? Tell everyone about your mother. Write a few words about your mother. '

Happy Mother's Day!

title: A heart touching story of a mother and her son
excerpt: A touching story about the unbreakable bond between a mother and her child.
fullContent:
Once upon a time, there lived a couple who had a son. The couple named him Mark. The couple were happy and raised their son in comfort without making him feel the discomfort of life. The son got married and brought his wife home. The father became ill suddenly and passed away. The mother was left under the care of the son. Mark’s wife became pregnant and she begot a child. Mark’s mother was happy to have become a grandma but her happiness was short-lived. Mark wanted to move abroad along with his family and was puzzled as to what to do with his mother. Mark’s wife gave him the idea to send the mother to an old age home where she will be taken care of. The old lady was shifted to the old age home where she had to spend the rest of her life. Mark used to call her once a week and used to talk with her. Later he stopped calling her. Mark’s mother waited every week for his call. One day she became seriously ill and was in the last few hours of her life, she took a piece of paper and wrote a letter and asked her warden to give it to Mark if he comes someday. One day, Mark came home from abroad just to find his mother gone forever to eternal life. He was shocked when he came to know about that and felt guilty that he didn’t care about his mother. Later, he went to the old age home where his mother lived and died. The warden of the old age home gave him the letter his mother wrote on her death bed. Mark took the letter and started to read. The letter read:

'Dear Son, I am not going to curse you for not taking care of me. I will not be blaming you for putting me in this old age home. I know that you are not aware that I am going to die in some time but I want you to promise me that you will do the things which I am going to tell you now. Do you know? There were times when I had to sleep without food here, the mattress was torn and I had to lie on the ground for getting a comfortable sleep. Huh! The fans here have become very old and need to be replaced. Please get these things fixed in this old age home where I am. You might be puzzled why this old lady who is going to die is telling all these things. Son! Today, I will be gone forever, but your son might send you to this old-age home someday and when you come you should not feel the discomfort.

Your loving Mom

Moral of the story: A mother will always love her child. So take care of her.
